title: Musicians Rose recorded and worked with
summary: Rose recorded Danny Barker, Dan Burley and Pops Foster, and knew Wellman Braud well. He did concerts and traveled with Bechet but never recorded him.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Is there one musician in particular you've worked the most with in your recording career?
Let's see. Gee, I'd have to stop and think about that. I mean, Danny Barker's made a lot of records with me.
I'd say outside of New Orleans.

Outside of New Orleans? Dan Burley. Of course, Danny Barker outside of New Orleans, too. Pops Foster. And I could never get away from New Orleans rhythm people, for one thing. And it's hard to think of who was the most.
Did you know Wellman Broad at all?
Bro. Yes, I knew him very well.
He did wonders for Duke, didn't he?
He certainly did, yeah. He was great. One of the greatest of the bass players.
And you've done stuff with Sidney Bache quite a bit, I would say.

I never recorded Sidney Bache. Oh, you never did record him? No. I knew him well, and I did a lot of concerts with him, and we traveled together, but I never made a record. No, you never made a record. No. Chips never fell that way. Okay. We must be to the end.
